senses.gloss:
1. कुऽ कु-, a contraction of क + व, from किम्. Former part of compound words, implying,
 I. Inferiority, wickedness, e. g. कु-कर्मन्,
 1. n. A wicked action, Pañc. v. d. 64.
 2. adj. Doing wicked actions, Bhāg. P. 1, 16, 22.
 कु-कृत्य, n. A shameful action, Pañc. 237, 21.
 कु-गो, m. An infirm bull, Rām. 6, 112, 6.
 कु-जननी, f. A bad mother, Rām. 6, 82, 118.
 कु-जन्मन्, adj. Having a bad origin, Bhāg. P. 4, 4, 22.
 कु-तनय, m. A son who has not turned out well, Pañc. i. d. 85.
 कु-तपस्विन्, m. A bad ascetic, Pañc. 126, 1.
 कु-तर्क, m. A false doctrine, Rājat. 5, 378.
 कु-दृष्ट, adj. Imperfectly seen, Pañc. v. d. 1.
 कु-दृष्टि, f. A false system, Man. 12, 95.
 कु-धी, adj. sbst. A fool, Pañc. i. d. 38.
 कु-नदिका, f. An insignificant rivulet, Pañc. i. d. 31.
 कु-पथ, m.
 1. An erroneous way, Bhāg. P. 6, 7, 14. []
 2. A proper name, Hariv. 203.
 कु-परीक्षक, m. A bad estimator, Bhartṛ. 2, 12.
 कु-परीक्षित, adj. Imperfectly examined, Pañc. v. d. 1.
 कु-पुत्र, m. A contemptible son, Man. 9, 161.
 कु-पुरुष, m.
 1. A contemptible man, MBh. 13, 108.
 2. A coward, 5, 5493.
 कु-प्लव, m. A frail boat, Man. 9, 161.
 कु-बुद्धि, adj.
 1. Foolish, Bhāg. P. 5, 5, 17.
 2. Mischievous, Pañc. i. d. 444.
 कु-भृत्य, m. A bad servant, Pañc. 83, 43.
 कु-मति,
 A. f.
 1. Perversity, Daśak. in Chr. 181, 7.
 2. Error, Bhāg. P. 1, 9, 36.
 B. adj. Foolish, Bhāg. P. 1, 15, 17.
 कु-मन्त्र, m. An evil advice, Bhāg. P. 3, 3, 13.
 कु-मन्त्रिन्, m. A bad counsellor, Rājat. 5, 455.
 कु-मार्ग, m. An erroneous way, Pañc. 122, 24.
 कु-मित्र, n. A false friend, Pañc. iii. d. 61.
 कु-मेधस्, adj. Mischievous, Bhāg. P. 3, 20, 33.
 कु-राजन्, m. A contemptible king, Pañc. v. d. 64.
 कु-रूप, adj. Ugly, Pañc. v. d. 17.
 कु-वर्ष, m. A heavy shower, Rām. 6, 89, 15.
 कु-वाक्य, n. Injurious speech, Pañc. v. d. 64.
 कु-विवाह, m. A culpable marriage, Man. 3, 63.
 कु-सचिव, m. A bad counsellor, Rājat. 5, 439.
 कु-सृति, adj. Walking in error; a sinner, Bhāg. P. 8, 23, 7.
 II. Surprise: How, cf. e. g. कुमार; how muc? cf. e. g. कुमुद.
3. कु कु, f. The earth, Bhāg. P. 6, 1, 42.
कू कू, and कु कु, ii. 2, Par., i. 1 and 6, Ātm., and as v. r. of क्नू, ii. 9, Par. Ātm. To cry. Frequent. कोकूय, cf. κωκύω; cf. आकूत.
